title: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), SLOs & Chaos Engineering
summary: Master SLIs/SLOs, Error Budgets, CrashLoopBackOff root-cause debugging, HorizontalPodAutoscalers, and Chaos Engineering resilience validation.
learningObjectives: Diagnose and recover workloads stuck in CrashLoopBackOff or CreateContainerConfigError.
Configure HorizontalPodAutoscalers (HPA) to elastically absorb traffic spikes.
Apply SLI/SLO error budget policies and lead blameless incident response.

curriculumModules.title: SLIs, SLOs, Error Budgets & Burn-Rate Alerting
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: An SLI is a quantitative measure of service quality (e.g. proportion of HTTP 2xx/3xx responses < 200ms). An SLO is the target (e.g. 99.9%), leaving a 0.1% Error Budget (43.2 minutes/month) for innovation and velocity.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Use multi-window, multi-burn-rate alerts (e.g. 2% budget consumed in 1 hour) to page on-call engineers only when the SLO is genuinely threatened.

curriculumModules.title: Elastic Autoscaling (HPA) & Chaos Engineering
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: HorizontalPodAutoscaler scales replica counts dynamically based on CPU, memory, or custom Prometheus metrics, while Chaos Engineering proactively injects faults to verify self-healing.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Combine HPA (`minReplicas >= 2`) with PodDisruptionBudgets (`minAvailable: 50%`) so node drains and chaos experiments never cause outages.

labs.title: CrashLoopBackOff Root-Cause Debugging & Recovery
labs.scenario: Critical deployment `order-processor` in `production` is failing in `CrashLoopBackOff` because environment variable `CRASH_ON_START` was set to `true`. Remediate the environment variable so all pods recover.
labs.productionContext: Misconfigured environment flags or feature toggles are among the top causes of production CrashLoopBackOff incidents.
objectives: Inspect logs or pod state for `order-processor` in `production`
Set `CRASH_ON_START=false` on `deployment/order-processor` in `production` so pods enter `Running` state
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: order-processor
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: order-processor
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: order-processor
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: processor
          image: ghcr.io/kubelabs/order-processor:v1.9.0
          env:
            - name: CRASH_ON_START
              value: "false"

steps.title: Inspect Failing Pods
steps.instruction: Run `kubectl get pods -n production` to confirm `order-processor` is in `CrashLoopBackOff`.

steps.title: Fix Environment Variable
steps.commandHint: kubectl set env deployment/order-processor CRASH_ON_START=false -n production

validationRules.description: Environment variable CRASH_ON_START set to false
validationRules.name: order-processor
validationRules.remediation: Run `kubectl set env deployment/order-processor CRASH_ON_START=false -n production`.

validationRules.name: order-processor
validationRules.remediation: Verify pods recover from CrashLoopBackOff to Running.

solutionCommands: kubectl set env deployment/order-processor CRASH_ON_START=false -n production
labs.troubleshootingGuide: Run `kubectl set env deployment/order-processor CRASH_ON_START=false -n production` and verify with `kubectl get pods -n production`.

labs.title: Configuring HorizontalPodAutoscaler for Elastic Resilience
labs.scenario: Configure an `HorizontalPodAutoscaler` for `api-gateway` in `production` scaling between `min=3` and `max=12` replicas at `70%` CPU utilization.
labs.productionContext: Elastic autoscaling prevents saturation cascading failures during unexpected traffic surges.
objectives: Set target CPU utilization to 70% to trigger elastic scaling under high traffic
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: api-gateway
  namespace: production
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    kind: Deployment
    name: api-gateway
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 12
  targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 70
labs.troubleshootingGuide: Check `kubectl describe hpa api-gateway -n production` to confirm `minReplicas: 3` and `maxReplicas: 12`.

assessmentQuestions.question: If a service has a 99.9% monthly availability SLO, approximately how much total downtime (Error Budget) is permitted per 30-day month?
assessmentQuestions.explanation: 0.1% of 30 days (43,200 minutes) equals 43.2 minutes of allowable error budget per month.

assessmentQuestions.question: What is the primary goal of a Blameless Postmortem in Site Reliability Engineering?
options: Identifying which individual engineer to penalize for an outage
Uncovering systemic contributing factors, improving automated guardrails, and preventing recurrence without fear of punishment
Hiding outage details from executive leadership
Deleting logs after an incident is resolved
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Blameless postmortems focus on systemic architecture, tooling, and process improvements rather than individual blame, encouraging transparent reporting.
